verdict.rationale: Kushki is a payments SaaS that processes merchant and cardholder data, so asking whether that data can be kept out of AI model training is a fair privacy-posture question. The evidence pack covers only payment integration docs (cards, 3DS, refunds, recurring charges, POS) and llms.txt/docs probes. Nothing documents an AI-training opt-out, a data-usage policy, or a commitment not to train on customer data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
